title: Did NOTHING!!!
text: Did NOTHING!!!. Boo!  We bought a cheap couch for son's room.  The cushions won't stay in place and it drives me CRAZY!  I hoped these grips would help but they did NOTHING.  I can't believe I paid so much including shipping for 3 of these.  RIP OFF!!!  If I hadn't already thrown away packaging, I would return them.

product_metadata.title: Cushion Stay Non-Slip Rubber Underlay, Keep Cushions from Moving, Slipping or Sliding (1)
